scope: Existing development logs and source only; post-hoc explanation, not causal attribution or model rescue

rrc_summary.checkpoint_selection_uses: teacher plus student validation output, not teacher alone

limitations: Loss magnitudes do not identify individual parameter-gradient norms.
Preclip gradient is the total objective gradient, not a mechanism-only gradient.
All analyses are observational post-hoc training-log descriptions, not randomized causal ablations.
The full 9-pair criterion and existing D1 shrink variants are reported; no market refit or new configuration is attempted.

clock_support_limitations: EU venue, instrument, contract roll, unit, snapshot version rules
Hubei Latest versus close semantics; 4 disagreement dates and 23 source dates missing from official snapshot
Dates are observed quote dates, not a fully authenticated session calendar
Historical first availability and subsequent revisions are not certified
limitations: Training objective logs include prediction shrink; unpenalized MSE and prediction amplitude are not separately identified.
Logged gradients are total parameter-gradient norms, not encoder-only or mechanism-only gradients.
A selected epoch0 checkpoint does not mean training was not executed.
BCM epoch0 is a training-fitted ridge readout; RRC epoch0 is an exactly zero output head. Do not merge these meanings.
No quote run-length, conditional signed mean or causal cross-market association is estimated here.
The existing pre2021 clock summary covers Guangzhou, Hubei and reported EU only, not Shanghai or EEX.
